en.headline: Police call repeat iPhone Duo credit-card reports extremely regrettable
en.dek: More than 110 reports involving about HK$4.6 million have been logged; officers say Apple has still not enabled 3D Secure despite earlier advice.
body: Police said on Saturday they had received more than 110 reports of suspected credit-card misuse linked to pre-orders of the iPhone Duo, involving about HK$4.6 million.

Senior Inspector Lo Chun-kong of the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau said the largest single report reached nearly HK$230,000, equivalent to about 12 handsets. No arrests have been made. The cases are being treated as obtaining property by deception.

Lo described the repeat of a similar pattern from last month’s iPhone pre-orders as extremely regrettable. He said police had advised Apple on multiple occasions since then to implement 3D Secure verification, under which the issuing bank requires additional confirmation such as a one-time password or approval in a banking app.

He said Apple had not activated the measure for Friday night’s pre-orders, and that the force was highly concerned the company had not fulfilled its corporate responsibilities, allowing fraudsters an opportunity. Police hope Apple will put effective preventive steps in place. Lo added that the earlier iPhone 18 Pro series incidents had produced more than 1,570 reports involving roughly HK$31 million.

zh.headline: 警方稱iPhone Duo信用卡舉報再現極度遺憾 批蘋果未啟用3DS
zh.dek: 網絡安全及科技罪案調查科高級督察盧震綱指接獲逾110宗報案、涉款約460萬元，最大一宗近23萬元，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方周六表示，已接獲逾110宗懷疑信用卡被盜用預訂iPhone Duo的報案，涉款約460萬元。
網絡安全及科技罪案調查科高級督察盧震綱說，單一損失最大金額近23萬元，約相等於12部手機。暫未有人被捕，案件列作以欺騙手段取得財產。
盧震綱形容，上月iPhone預購曾出現同類情況後再度發生，令人極度遺憾。他指警方其後多次建議蘋果啟用3DS網上信用卡交易驗證，由發卡銀行要求持卡人作額外確認，例如輸入一次性密碼或經銀行應用程式批核。
他說蘋果在周五晚預購期間仍未啟用該機制，警方高度關注公司未有積極承擔企業責任，讓不法分子有機可乘，並期望盡快落實有效預防措施。盧震綱補充，上月iPhone 18 Pro系列事件至今已有逾1570宗報案，涉款約3100萬元。
